; Suika3 NovelML-inspired script. One file per chapter.
; ASCII-first text until glyph safety is proven on the pc98 build.
[chapter id="ch01" title="Chapter 1 - Matsuri Lights"]
[bg file="bg/matsuri.png"]
[ch file="ch/jolly.png" pos="left"]
[text]Summer festival street, night. Paper lanterns, fireworks, glowing stalls.[/text]
[text speaker="Jolly"]Waa! So many festival lights... My orb has competition tonight![/text]
[text speaker="Jolly"]Look - two stalls at the end of the street. I can only pick one treat before the fireworks finale.[/text]
[bg file="bg/matsuri.png"]
[text speaker="Jolly"]Which one should I get? Choose carefully - Chapter 2 starts from this choice.[/text]
[choose id="treat"]
[option id="ringo" label="Buy the apple candy (ringo-ame)"]Get the glossy apple candy.[/option]
[option id="wataame" label="Buy the cotton candy (wata-ame)"]Get the fluffy cotton candy.[/option]
[/choose]
[label id="after-ringo"]
[bg file="bg/matsuri.png"]
[text speaker="Jolly"]Apple candy! Crunchy, shiny, like a tiny festival lantern I can eat.[/text]
[text]Jolly holds the apple candy up beside the orb. Both glow red and blue under the fireworks.[/text]
[goto endcard]
[label id="after-wataame"]
[bg file="bg/matsuri.png"]
[text speaker="Jolly"]Cotton candy! A sweet little cloud on a stick. It looks like my fur![/text]
[text]Jolly holds the cotton candy up beside the orb. Both glow pink and blue under the fireworks.[/text]
[label id="endcard"]
[endcard chapter="ch01" next="generate"]
[text speaker="Jolly"]The fireworks are starting... Tomorrow will be a new day. (End of Chapter 1)[/text]
[end]
